name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
description: Wallpaper Engine backgrounds for the DSH web GUI: render your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the chat — Scene and Web in real time through the bundled WebWallGL engine, Video played directly — with iOS-style liquid glass, adjustable blur/scrim/border/opacity, custom typography and caret, and a liquid-glass makeover of the whole settings window. Prerequisite: DeepSeek Harness kernel >= 0.1.5 (0.1.5-rc.1+ — the official desktop line and DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7 both qualify). No version restriction on dsh-better-sidebar.
